title: Integrate Bootstrap styling into a framework-based frontend
prompt: Document a small framework integration boundary and demonstrate a Bootstrap-styled component without competing DOM ownership.
objective: The framework owns its state and markup; plugin initialization does not conflict with framework rendering.

acceptance_criteria: Include and correctly use `framework` where it belongs.
